# BGE Large EN Embedding Pipeline (Isolated)

This folder provides an **isolated** pipeline for running VOTR with
`BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5` embeddings, without changing the existing OpenAI or
Gemma code paths.

## What stays untouched

- Existing router entrypoint: `mcp_router.router:app`
- Existing OpenAI index: `data/index`
- Existing Gemma index: `data/index_gemma`
- Existing benchmark outputs:
  - `benchmarks/results/functional_correctness`
  - `benchmarks/results/functional_correctness_gemma`

## What this folder adds

- Local embedder: `experiments/bge_large_en/embedder_bge.py`
- BGE router app: `experiments/bge_large_en/router_bge.py`
- Meta -> embedding JSON builder: `experiments/bge_large_en/build_embedding_json_from_meta.py`
- One-shot benchmark runner: `experiments/bge_large_en/run_all_suites_bge.py`
- Separate config: `experiments/bge_large_en/config.bge.yaml`

## 1) Install dependencies

```powershell
pip install sentence-transformers torch huggingface_hub
```

## 2) Build BGE embedding JSON from existing metadata

Input source: `data/index/meta.json` (text fields only)

Output: `data/bge_large_en/mcp_tools_with_embedding.bge-large-en-v1.5.json`

```powershell
python experiments/bge_large_en/build_embedding_json_from_meta.py `
  --meta data/index/meta.json `
  --model BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 `
  --out data/bge_large_en/mcp_tools_with_embedding.bge-large-en-v1.5.json
```

## 3) Build a separate BGE index

```powershell
python scripts/build_index.py `
  --input data/bge_large_en/mcp_tools_with_embedding.bge-large-en-v1.5.json `
  --output data/index_bge_large_en
```

## 4) Run BGE router only

```powershell
python -m uvicorn experiments.bge_large_en.router_bge:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8776
```

Health check:

```powershell
curl http://127.0.0.1:8776/health
```

## 5) Run full functional suite against BGE router

This writes to `benchmarks/results/functional_correctness_bge_large_en`.

```powershell
python experiments/bge_large_en/run_all_suites_bge.py
```

## Notes

- No existing OpenAI or Gemma pipeline files are replaced by this workflow.
- Different embedding dimensionality is expected and valid because both
  index-time and query-time embeddings are generated by the same model.
- For per-query/per-item exhaustive raw records, use the report files listed
  above; this README centralizes the complete suite-level summary data.
